description: Amenon wears an opaque pale-linen long tunic with long sleeves and narrow gold-brown geometric woven borders along the round neckline, center front, cuffs and hem. A plum-purple layered noble outer robe has broad worked gold borders and falls below the knees, with a draped matching panel over one shoulder. Two circular gold brooches and a short chain secure the upper robe. A dark decorated belt with a round worked clasp and hanging ornamental strip fits the waist. Dark brown leather boots are fully visible beneath the layered tunic. There is no headgear, armor or weapon. Fine linen, rich woven edging and restrained drapery communicate high noble Imperial clothing.
